room_rent.note: Policy wording does not explicitly cap room rent; shared accommodation triggers a daily cash benefit, implying higher rooms are allowed but no explicit room rent sub-limit is stated in the wording provided.

icu.note: No explicit ICU room rent cap found in the policy wording.

copayment.note: No mandatory co-payment; policy explicitly states no co-payment if insured from lower tier avails treatment in higher tier.

sub_limits.note: Maternity has fixed limits (₹15k–₹50k depending on plan/type); ambulance capped at ₹2,000/hospitalisation; daily cash for shared room capped; air ambulance ₹2.5L. Core inpatient treatment covered up to SI with no disease-wise sub-limits mentioned.

deductible.note: No aggregate deductible mentioned in the policy wording.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; accidents exempt.

ped_waiting.note: Pre-existing disease waiting period is 36 months of continuous coverage. Reducible via portability/migration credit.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Listed conditions (ENT, gynaecological, orthopaedic, GI, urogenital, cataract, varicose veins, tumours/cysts etc.) have 24-month waiting period.

maternity.display: Optional add-on (Standard: 6yr wait; Exclusive: 4yr wait; Family Exclusive: 3yr wait)
maternity.note: Not covered in Standard Individual plan; available in Standard and Exclusive variants with limits: Normal delivery ₹15k–₹30k, Caesarean ₹25k–₹50k depending on plan. Waiting period 6 years (Standard Individual), 4 years (Standard/Exclusive Family & Exclusive Individual), 3 years (Family Exclusive). Limited to 2 deliveries/terminations lifetime.

cumulative_bonus.note: 10% of Base SI added each policy year irrespective of claims, maximum 100% of Base SI.

restoration.note: No sum insured restoration/reset benefit mentioned in the policy wording.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for 60 days before admission.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for 90 days after discharge.

day_care.note: Day care procedures under general or local anaesthesia requiring less than 24-hour admission are covered.

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary treatment covered when patient cannot be moved to hospital or no room available; pre/post-hosp expenses also covered.

ayush.note: AYUSH inpatient treatment covered up to Sum Insured in AYUSH hospitals.

organ_donor.note: Medical and surgical expenses of organ donor for harvesting covered when insured is recipient. Donor's pre/post-hosp and insured's own donation expenses excluded.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered up to ₹2,000 per hospitalisation. Air ambulance up to ₹2.5L available in Exclusive plan.

modern_treatments.note: Policy wording does not explicitly mention modern/robotic treatments as a named benefit or exclusion.

consumables.note: Annexure I lists many consumables (gloves, masks, etc.) as non-payable items. No consumables cover rider mentioned.

global_cover.note: Policy explicitly covers treatment within India only; treatment outside India is a specific exclusion.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage, no claim/policy contestable except on grounds of established fraud.

grace_period.note: 30 days grace for yearly/half-yearly/quarterly; 15 days for monthly instalment.

free_look.note: 30-day free-look period on new policies; not applicable on renewals or portability.

portability.note: Portability as per IRDAI guidelines; apply at least 30 days before renewal.

notable_exclusions.display: Sleep apnoea, external congenital anomalies, hearing aids/spectacles, dental (unless hospitalised), intra-articular injections admission, treatment outside India

optional_riders.display: Critical Illness lump sum (50%/100% of SI), Newborn Baby benefit, Recovery Benefit (₹10k), Emergency Air Ambulance (₹2.5L)
